description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the behavior of DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests that verify answer building logic for delete feature property commands, including handling of responses and errors.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing various response scenarios and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock command and the answer builder instance before each test.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that creating a new instance with null command throws NullPointerException.
